import os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
paths=[Path.cwd(),Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir'],text=True).strip()),Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--path-format=absolute','--git-common-dir'],text=True).strip())]
for p in paths:
 assert os.statvfs(p).f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY,p
 print('read-only mount:',p)
